properties.title: Wellhead Release, East Bay, LA
properties.content: At 0640 on 5NOV12, USCG Sector New Orleans contacted NOAA SSC about a report of a wellhead releasing unknown product into the water. The location was described as "Northern East Bay" without precise coordinates. The release began early in the morning, exact time unknown and the rate of discharge is unknown. The release is unsecured and overflight is scheduled. There is limited information at this time and further investigation is required. USCG requested a trajectory to aid with field activities.

properties.title: Exxon Mobil, Baton Rouge, LA
properties.content: USCG MSU Baton Rouge contacted their NOAA SSC to request a precautionary “what if” trajectory for a 5 bbl spill of Doba Blend crude oil near Baton Rouge, LA at MM232 on the Lower Mississippi River.  The spill occurred at the 0345 hours (local) on 05-SEP-2012 at an Exxon facility on the Left Descending Bank.  Presently, most of the product is contained near the release location, so MSU Baton Rouge requested a precautionary trajectory estimate in the event some product is lost from containment prior to the conclusion of cleanup operations.
